Paragraph: "The bull elephant leads his herd with pride, ensuring every mate and calf is safe beside him..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Noticing the leader elephant guarding and guiding his family.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama praises the protective leadership shown by the elephant.
Outcome/Resolution: He reflects on duty, family leadership, and protection.
